maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost keypoints are aligned in a linear formation, approximately parallel to the dense secondary row below, with consistent inter-point spacing.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: The rhinarium displays high melanin saturation, covering approximately 95% of the apex with dark pixels, and a minimal lighter region centrally located.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white fur patches are present on the chin and infraorbital regions, contrasted by distinct dark lacrimal stripes extending from the medial canthi.
